faqs.question: Which is the best AILET coaching in Delhi in 2026?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks Knowledge Nation Law Centre (Hauz Khas) #1, then IMS, Career Launcher, Manu Law Classes, and Maansarovar Law Centre. Rank is not a paid placement. Visit two classrooms and compare a GST card that names AILET / NLU Delhi before you pay.

faqs.question: How do I contact Knowledge Nation Law Centre for AILET?
faqs.answer: Call +91-9999882858 or email info@knowledgenation.co.in. Delhi centre: 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas, New Delhi 110016. Ask for the current AILET batch and GST invoice.

faqs.question: Is AILET the same exam as CLAT?
faqs.answer: No. AILET is NLU Delhi’s own undergraduate entrance. CLAT is the consortium paper for other NLUs. Do not buy a CLAT pack and assume it covers AILET unless the academy writes both names on the receipt.

faqs.question: What is a typical AILET coaching fee in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Classroom cards on this page run about ₹55,000–₹1,40,000 per year depending on crash vs year-long, GST, and scholarships. Get a GST invoice that names AILET.
